empty_panel: Start this game from Runs → Play run to track a run.
empty_screen: Open a run under Runs to see it here, or start this game with Runs → Play run.
hud_empty: SoulLink: start this game from Runs → Play run
no_player_text: Your run state appears as soon as the game is ready.
loc_unknown: Pick the place you are on
grave_hint: Linked deaths are grouped. Undo asks for a reason that everyone sees in the log.
hud_death: Group {n} died: {mon}, {count} linked partners died too
note_death_own: Your {mon} fainted. {n} linked partners are dead too.
note_death_linked: {player}'s {mon} fainted. Your linked {mine} is dead too.
ev_why_extra: Does not count: route already used.
ev_c_undo_death: {player} undid the death of the link group on {route}. {reason}
c_title_undo_death: Undo the death of this link group?
c_dc_text: {route} stays open for you. {others} see this in the log.
c_undo_text: Everyone in the run sees this with your reason (group {n}).
c_group_text: Moving {mon} also changes who dies with it.
c_missed_text: Others can still catch there, but their catches won't be linked to you.
c_dead_text: Your linked partners die too. The game keeps running.
c_revert_text: Revert correction #{seq}? Everyone sees this in the log.
c_enter_hint: Confirm each text field with Enter.
c_err_post: The run does not accept changes right now.
c_confirm_text_undo_death: All linked creatures come back where they were.
c_confirm_text_mark_dead: The creature counts as dead for the whole link group.
c_confirm_text_mark_missed: Logged as manual and visible to all run members.
c_confirm_text_revert: The correction is cancelled for everyone.
rs_first_encounter_only_hint: Only the first creature on each route counts.
rs_dupes_clause_hint: Re-roll if you already own that line.
rs_pairs_differ_primary_type: Linked pairs differ in primary type
rs_pairs_differ_primary_type_hint: Linked creatures need different primary types.
rs_only_linked_in_team: Only linked pairs in the team
rs_only_linked_in_team_hint: A creature joins the team only with all its partners.
rs_level_caps_hint: Shows the next gym's cap, never blocks.
zone_new_text: Which route is this? Your answer is remembered and shared with the run.
calib_hint: Pick a place, move the cross to its spot on the map and set the position.
update_to_open: Update Uzume to open the run screen
ev_why_type: Does not count: same primary type as a partner.
map_empty_text: Routes and catches are listed in the Routes tab meanwhile. The map image stays on this computer.
map_hint: Open the map in the game on the bottom screen, for example the PokéNav AreaNav or the Fly map, then take it from the screen.
map_remove_text: Only the map image is removed. Recorded route positions stay saved.
map_no_api: This version of Uzume cannot take the map from the game picture. Update Uzume to use the map.
map_err_busy: A capture is still running. Try again in a moment.
map_err_rate_limited: Too fast. Wait a second and try again.
map_err_no_frame: No game picture yet. Make sure the game runs and is not paused.
map_err_unknown_screen: The game screen was not found.
map_err_invalid_rect: The picture area is not valid.
map_err_too_large: The picture is too large to keep.
map_err_unsupported: The map can only be taken from the game running in this app, not from a viewed session.
map_err_denied: The app refused to take the picture.
map_err_failed: The map could not be taken. Try again.
calib_no_places: No places from the game yet
map_files_hint: Browse the large images the plugin found in your own game files and pick the region map. Nothing leaves this computer.
map_files_searching: Still searching the game files. This can take a few minutes; the images appear here when the search is finished.
map_files_none: No suitable images were found in the game files. Take the map from the screen instead.
map_files_failed: This image could not be shown. Try the next one.
map_files_suggested: The game data plugin suggests this image.
map_files_current: This is the map in use.
diag_hint: Send a screenshot of this if places or names are missing.
icheck_hint: Tell us which picture looks right
crop_hint: Percent of the game screen cut off on each side. The map is taken again with this crop; it only shows what the game displays right now.
crop_rescale: Recorded route positions move with the crop.
c_title_undo_death_n: Undo the death of link group {n}?
c_add_text_missed: Replaces 'missed' on {route}. Marked manual for everyone.
c_who: Logged as manual with your name. {others} see it and can undo it from the log.
c_who_alone: Logged as manual with your name.
rs_balls_required: Encounters count only once you have Poké Balls
rs_balls_required_hint: Encounters before your first Poké Ball do not count and do not use up the route.
balls_hint: Encounters don't count until you have Poké Balls.
loc_no_balls: Not counted: no Poké Balls yet
ev_why_no_balls: Not counted: no Poké Balls yet.
c_reopen_text: {route} is open again: your next encounter there counts as the first.
